candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get fever. Dis fever don last for 2 days. Dem check im temperature, e be 38.0°C. For where we dey, na high malaria risk. Malaria test dey available, dem do am and e show negative. Pikin get rash wey spread for body. E no get cough or difficult to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get runny nose. E no get stiff neck. Dem no see obvious reason for the fever. E no get mouth ulcer. E no get deep or big mouth ulcer. E never get measles for the last 3 months. E no get cough wey join measles. Dem see pus dey come out from im eye. E eye red. E no get clouding for cornea. E never convulse and im body never shake. E no dey convulse now. E no dey weak or unconscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Dem no identify bacterial cause for this assessment.
